Claw marks on the wall are layered one over another, the highest higher than his head. Fengfeng sets down his pack and measures the width of the room. Fengfeng: "Four steps wide. Room enough to swing a sword."
封封拔劍，劍尖對準牆上最深的那道爪痕，順著它一劍一劍刺進去。刺到第十下，他才發現: Fengfeng draws his sword, aims the tip at the deepest claw mark on the wall, and thrusts into it one stroke at a time. Only on the tenth thrust does he notice he always swings an extra half circle when withdrawing the blade. Fengfeng: "Pull the sword back in a straight line, and I won't sweep the person next to me."
封封把劍放到身旁，靠牆坐下，沒多久就睡著了。醒來活動肩膀，先前的痠痛已經好了一些: Fengfeng lays his sword down beside him, sits against the wall, and is soon asleep. When he wakes and works his shoulders, the earlier soreness has eased somewhat. Fengfeng: "I slept soundly. It's quiet outside now."
牆縫裡卡著一只小箱子，箱蓋貼了張說得不清不楚的紙條。封封蹲到側面查看，沒有立刻伸: A small box is wedged in a crack in the wall, with a note stuck on its lid that says things vaguely. Fengfeng crouches to look at it from the side and doesn't reach for it right away.
